top_signals.title: RBC's Amy Wu Silverman on AI Slowdown, Fed Expectations
top_signals.summary: Amy Wu Silverman, RBC Capital Markets Head of Derivatives Strategy, joins Bloomberg's Anna Edwards on "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss her expectations ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting later this week and shares her reaction to tech leaders calling for a slowdown in AI models. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
